excerpt.rendered: Sherwood School District continues to take steps to more fully engage students, families, and staff in activities and information related to the diverse experiences in the Sherwood community. In order to accomplish this goal, the Sherwood School District utilizes the Oregon School Board Association’s awareness calendar, which brings about information related to widely recognized awarenesses that have been proclaimed or adopted through a governmental process. Please help us celebrate and honor the diversity within our school communities while we foster environments of understanding, respect, and belonging.
